# Okosotthon.bolt.hu Emails and Updates

## Context

Collection of promotions, updates, and offers from Okosotthon Bolt sent via email. These cover product discounts, store updates, special offers, and new product announcements, all related to smart home devices and accessories.

## Key Points

1. Multiple promotional campaigns focusing on AQARA sensors, with discounts ranging from -15% to -20%, and tailored for the month of May.
2. Web shop updates highlighting a renewed website and user instructions.
3. Special spring campaigns for AQARA products, running through April 30.
4. Limited-time offers such as a 1-year eWeLink subscription valid until April 27, 2026.
5. Price reductions on Shelly products.
6. Introduction of new devices: AQARA G400 video doorbell, G350 camera with local AI, Matter support, Wi-Fi 6.
7. Return of Sonoff products, indicating ongoing inventory refresh.

## Action Items
- Monitor these product campaigns for potential customer outreach.
- Update product or project records if relevant.
- Create follow-up tasks for checking stock levels or preparing marketing content.
